maddeler.e:
تحتقبوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَقِبُوا (taḥtaqibū) /taħ.ta.qi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# تُحْتَقَبُوا (tuḥtaqabū) /tuħ.ta.qa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
